svg.title: AI Academy Level 2 motif sprite sheet
svg.desc: A hidden library of reusable motif symbols for Level 2 figures: code, data, charts and errors.

symbol.title: A variable as a labelled box
symbol.desc: A luggage-label tag reading score is attached to a box holding the value 7.

symbol.title: Rebinding a variable
symbol.desc: Two panels. Before: the box labelled score holds 7. After: the same box holds 10 and the old 7 is struck through.

symbol.title: A list as numbered slots
symbol.desc: Five slots side by side holding 3, 8, 1, 9 and 4, numbered 0 to 4 underneath, with a bracket above labelled len = 5.

symbol.title: A dictionary as key to value pairs
symbol.desc: Three rows. Each has a key box on the left, an arrow, and a value box on the right: player to Meera, runs to 48, ground to Pune.

symbol.title: A for loop as one trip round a circle
symbol.desc: A near-complete circular arrow with a counter reading i equals 2 in the middle, above a row of four numbered slots with slot 2 highlighted.

symbol.title: An if/else as a fork in the path
symbol.desc: A signpost reading hot outside? stands over a path that forks. The left branch is labelled yes and leads to fan on; the right is labelled no and leads to fan off.

symbol.title: A function as a machine with a hopper and a chute
symbol.desc: A funnel-shaped input hopper feeds a box named average, which empties through a chute at the bottom.

symbol.title: A call stack as stacked trays
symbol.desc: Three trays stacked on the ground. main is at the bottom, then total, then average on top, marked as the one running now.

symbol.title: A DataFrame as a grid with a header row and an index
symbol.desc: A three-row table with a bold header row reading player, runs, over, a grey index column numbered 0 to 2, and the runs column outlined and tinted as the current selection.

symbol.title: A 1-D numpy array as one contiguous row
symbol.desc: Five square cells butted together holding 1 to 5, with a bracket above and the annotation shape open bracket 5 comma close bracket below.

symbol.title: A 2-D numpy array as a shaped block
symbol.desc: A block of three rows by four columns of numbers, with axis 0 arrowed downwards, axis 1 arrowed across, and the annotation shape 3 comma 4 below.

symbol.title: A scatter plot skeleton
symbol.desc: A scatter plot with a labelled y axis, a labelled x axis, three grid lines and seven dots rising to the right.

symbol.title: A bar chart skeleton
symbol.desc: A bar chart with four bars labelled Mon to Thu, each printing its own value above it.

symbol.title: A line chart skeleton
symbol.desc: A line chart with one series of five points joined left to right, each point marked with a hollow circle.

symbol.title: A train/test split as one cut of the deck
symbol.desc: A deck of 100 rows is cut by a dashed line into a train pile of 80 rows and a test pile of 20 rows.
symbol.text: one cut, then never mix them

symbol.title: A kNN vote: query point, three neighbours, tally
symbol.desc: A pink square marked with a question mark sits among circles and triangles. A dashed ring labelled k equals 3 encloses two triangles and one circle. Below, a tally reads orange times 2 wins, apple times 1.

symbol.title: A decision tree as boxes and yes/no branches
symbol.desc: A question box reading petal long? branches no to a second question wide? and yes to the answer setosa. The second question branches to virginica and versicolor.

symbol.title: Underfitting: a line too simple for the data
symbol.desc: Eight dots climb to the right. A flat straight line ignores the climb entirely; the caption reads too simple.

symbol.title: A good fit: a curve that follows the trend
symbol.desc: The same eight dots, with a smooth curve running through the middle of the climb; the caption reads just right.

symbol.title: Overfitting: a wiggle through every point
symbol.desc: The same eight dots, with a jagged line that detours to pass exactly through each one; the caption reads memorised.

symbol.title: A terminal window frame
symbol.desc: A console window with a title bar reading Terminal. Inside, a prompt runs python hello.py, the output line reads hello, world, and a fresh prompt waits with a block cursor.

symbol.title: A traceback, with the offending line marked
symbol.desc: A console panel outlined in red shows a four-line Python traceback. The line that failed is highlighted and an arrow points at it from the right. The last line, a NameError, is printed in red.

symbol.title: One line of code with a callout on one token
symbol.desc: A single line of code sits on a grey strip. The word price is boxed in pink and an arrow points up at it from a label reading a name, not a value.

symbol.title: Arrow pointing right
symbol.desc: A straight arrow pointing to the right.

symbol.title: Curved arrow
symbol.desc: A curved arrow that loops up and over to the right.

symbol.title: Correct badge
symbol.desc: A round badge with a tick inside, meaning correct.

symbol.title: Wrong badge
symbol.desc: A round badge with a cross inside, meaning wrong.

symbol.title: Labelled box
symbol.desc: A rounded box with a label inside.

symbol.title: Sticky note
symbol.desc: A sticky note with a folded corner and three lines of writing.

symbol.title: Data table
symbol.desc: A small data table with a shaded header row and six cells.

symbol.title: Child's face
symbol.desc: A smiling child's face with short hair.
